error_message: Expected all tensors to be on the same device, but got mat1 is on cpu, different from other tensors on cuda:0
root_cause: PyG Data.to() and Data.cpu() mutate their receiving graph. The initial round-trip check moved the same graph used for inference back to CPU after it had been moved to CUDA.
fix_policy: Keep the inference graph on device and validate the CPU round-trip using a separate clone.
run_id_policy: run_001 is terminal. Any recovery uses a new ID and is independently preregistered.
